statements.action_statement: bc-fips stays at 2.1.1, the only version CMVP certificate #4943 validates. The fix is in bc-fips 2.1.3, which is not validated; moving to it would mean running an unvalidated module. The image will move to a validated release containing the fix once CMVP lists one. Until then, don't rely on X.509 name constraints alone to restrict what a constrained CA can issue for; also pin or allow-list the expected certificates or issuers where that matters.
